sqlite_records.meaning: Read selected comma-separated column names from a read-only SQLite table. Choose a comma-separated list of name:asc or name:desc order keys. Selected fields break remaining ties. Return text and numbers as strings; reject null and blob values.

xml_records.meaning: Select XML records by XPath in document order and read exactly one node or attribute per comma-separated relative XPath. Return decoded attribute values or direct element text.

zip_file_records.meaning: Read regular ZIP members in archive order. Choose comma-separated path, size, parent, base, top, depth, ext or payload fields. Payload is exact hexadecimal bytes. Top and parent use a dot for root; ext is the ASCII-lowercase final suffix without its dot. Also accepts folded_base, hidden_name, hidden_parent and component=NAME.

tree_file_records.meaning: Walk regular files recursively without following symbolic links. Return rows sorted by relative path. Choose path, base, folded_base, size, parent, top, ext, depth, payload (exact hex), hidden_name, hidden_parent or component=NAME (parent component test).

uri_records.meaning: Ignore comments and blank lines using the catalog URI reader. Parse absolute URIs preserving encounter order. Choose original, ASCII-lowercase host or scheme, exact fragment-free base and has_fragment (0 or 1).
